title: Builder
description: Create new tables with their list and form from a description or an Excel or CSV file
intro: Describe what you want to manage or upload an Excel or CSV file (or both). The AI proposes the table, list and form; you review it, ask for changes or edit the proposal, and only when you confirm are the database table and module files created and, if you uploaded a file, its rows imported.

ask.label: What do you want to manage?
ask.placeholder: E.g. "projects with client, owner, start and delivery dates, budget and status (pending, in progress, delivered)"
ask.file_help: First sheet of the .xlsx or .csv with headers; up to 20 MB and 50,000 rows. Its columns are used to propose the fields and imported when the module is created.
ask.working: The AI is designing the module…
ask.empty: Write a description or upload a file.

file.too_big: The file is larger than 20 MB.
file.upload: The file could not be uploaded.

file_truncated: only the first 50,000 will be imported

errors.title: Fix this before creating the module
errors.name: The name "{name}" is not valid: lowercase letters without accents, digits and _, starting with a letter, and not a MySQL reserved word.
errors.table_exists: A table "{name}" already exists in the database.
errors.fields_count: The module needs between 1 and {max} fields.
errors.field_name: The field name "{field}" is not valid (lowercase, digits and _; not "id" or "created_at", which are added automatically; no reserved words such as order or group).
errors.field_type: The field "{field}" has an unknown type: "{type}".
errors.option: The option "{value}" of the field "{field}" is not valid or is repeated.
errors.options_count: The list "{field}" needs between 1 and 100 options or a relation to another table.
errors.source_table: The field "{field}" refers to "{table}", which does not exist.
errors.source_pk: The table "{table}" of the field "{field}" does not have a single-column primary key.
errors.source_label: There is no text column to show from the table "{table}" in the field "{field}".

refine.label: Ask the AI for changes
refine.placeholder: Ask for changes, e.g. "add a phone field" or "status with the options open, on hold and closed"
refine.empty: Write what you want to change.

confirm_create: The table "{name}" and the module files will be created. Continue?
confirm_create_import: The table "{name}" and the module files will be created and {rows} rows imported. Continue?
not_writable: Cannot write to {dirs}: give the web server write permission to create modules.
no_draft: There is no proposal in progress.
ai_failed: The AI did not return a valid proposal. Try another description.

flash.has_errors: Fix the errors before creating the module.
flash.invalid_module: The generated module is not valid: {error}
flash.sql_error: The table could not be created: {error}
flash.truncated: {n} texts shortened because they were too long.
flash.import_error: The rows could not be imported: {error}
